headline: Where is my money going?
lede: Track every purchase for three months before you change anything.

pin.title: Where Is My Money Going? How to Find Out
pin.description: Write down every purchase for about three months before you adjust anything. One month can miss an annual renewal or an unusually busy stretch, like the holidays; three months gets closer to the truth. Then every change is a real number next to a real category.
pin.alt: Article pin: Where is my money going? Track every purchase for three months before you change anything.
